queries.runs_page: SELECT run_id, name, config, datasets, status, created_at, completed_at, summary, error, project_id, CAST(ROUND((julianday(completed_at) - julianday(created_at)) * 86400.0, 3) AS INTEGER) AS duration_seconds FROM runs WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR project_id = ?1) ORDER BY created_at DESC, run_id ASC LIMIT ?2 OFFSET ?3
queries.runs_total: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR project_id = ?1)
queries.run_counts: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pr.refit_context IS NOT NULL THEN pr.chain_id END) AS final_models_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pr.refit_context IS NULL AND pr.fold_id NOT IN ('avg', 'w_avg') AND pr.fold_id NOT LIKE '%_agg' THEN pr.fold_id END) AS total_folds, COUNT(CASE WHEN pr.partition = 'val' AND pr.refit_context IS NULL AND pr.fold_id NOT IN ('avg', 'w_avg') AND pr.fold_id NOT LIKE '%_agg' THEN 1 END) AS total_models_trained, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pipelines WHERE run_id = ?1) AS pipeline_runs_count FROM predictions AS pr JOIN pipelines AS pl ON pl.pipeline_id = pr.pipeline_id WHERE pl.run_id = ?1
queries.run_model_classes: SELECT c.model_class AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM chains AS c JOIN pipelines AS pl ON pl.pipeline_id = c.pipeline_id WHERE pl.run_id = ?1 GROUP BY c.model_class ORDER BY count DESC, c.model_class ASC
queries.run_artifact_size: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.size_bytes), 0) FROM artifacts AS a WHERE a.artifact_id IN (SELECT j.value FROM chains AS c JOIN pipelines AS pl ON pl.pipeline_id = c.pipeline_id, json_tree(c.fold_artifacts) AS j WHERE pl.run_id = ?1 AND j.type = 'text' UNION SELECT j.value FROM chains AS c JOIN pipelines AS pl ON pl.pipeline_id = c.pipeline_id, json_tree(c.shared_artifacts) AS j WHERE pl.run_id = ?1 AND j.type = 'text')
queries.run_stats: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'running' THEN 1 END) AS running, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'queued' THEN 1 END) AS queued, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) AS completed, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 END) AS failed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pipelines) AS total_pipelines, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) AS cancelled, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'partial' THEN 1 END) AS partial, COUNT(*) AS total FROM runs
queries.run_dataset_metadata: SELECT pr.dataset_name, pr.n_samples, pr.n_features, pr.task_type, pr.metric FROM predictions AS pr JOIN pipelines AS pl ON pl.pipeline_id = pr.pipeline_id WHERE pl.run_id = ?1 ORDER BY pr.rowid ASC
queries.runs_filtered_page: SELECT run_id, name, config, datasets, status, created_at, completed_at, summary, error, project_id, CAST(ROUND((julianday(completed_at) - julianday(created_at)) * 86400.0, 3) AS INTEGER) AS duration_seconds FROM runs WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR project_id = ?1) AND (json_array_length(?4) = 0 OR status IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?4))) ORDER BY created_at DESC, run_id ASC LIMIT ?2 OFFSET ?3
queries.runs_filtered_total: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR project_id = ?1) AND (json_array_length(?2) = 0 OR status IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?2)))
queries.page_chains: SELECT c.chain_id, c.pipeline_id, p.run_id, p.name AS pipeline_name, p.expanded_config, c.model_step_idx, c.dataset_name, c.metric, c.task_type, c.model_name, c.model_class, c.preprocessings, c.cv_val_score, c.cv_test_score, c.cv_train_score, c.cv_fold_count, c.cv_scores, c.final_test_score, c.final_train_score, c.final_scores, c.final_agg_test_score, c.final_agg_train_score, c.final_agg_scores, c.best_params FROM chains AS c JOIN pipelines AS p ON p.pipeline_id = c.pipeline_id WHERE p.run_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM predictions AS pr WHERE pr.chain_id = c.chain_id) ORDER BY c.chain_id ASC LIMIT ?2 OFFSET ?3
queries.historical_score_extrema: SELECT MIN(c.cv_val_score), MAX(c.cv_val_score) FROM chains AS c JOIN pipelines AS p ON p.pipeline_id = c.pipeline_id WHERE c.dataset_name = ?1 AND c.metric = ?2 AND p.run_id != ?3 AND c.cv_val_score BETWEEN -1.7976931348623157e308 AND 1.7976931348623157e308 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM predictions AS pr WHERE pr.chain_id = c.chain_id)

semantics.metadata: same fields and null normalization as studio_run_detail_v1; names and project identities remain exact
semantics.duration_seconds: whole elapsed seconds from stored timestamps, millisecond precision; null for absent or unparseable timestamps
semantics.counts: stored prediction metadata only; no inferred folds or invented final models
semantics.artifact_size_bytes: sum each distinct registered artifact once, including nested fold/shared references; no filesystem traversal
semantics.scores: consume workspace-store-results-summary.v1 sources for selected run ids only; never compute scientific metrics from prediction arrays
semantics.historical_gain: finite MIN/MAX for each selected run/dataset/exact metric cohort, excluding that run but not filtering other runs by page/project/status; same signed current-minus-historical-best
semantics.dataset_metadata: first stored prediction metadata per dataset, used only when run dataset metadata is absent; no inferred dimensions
